title: New law: An Act to amend the Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1990 to permit medicare select policies to be offered in all States. (Public Law 104-18)
summary: H.R. 483 of the 104th Congress became Public Law 104-18 on 1995-07-07.

title: New law: A bill to extend authorities under the Middle East Peace Facilitation Act of 1994 until August 15, 1995. (Public Law 104-17)
summary: S. 962 of the 104th Congress became Public Law 104-17 on 1995-07-02.

title: New law: A bill to amend the Colorado River Basin Salinity Control Act to authorize additional measures to carry out the control of salinity upstream of Imperial Dam in a cost-effective manner, and for other purposes. (Public Law 104-20)
summary: S. 523 of the 104th Congress became Public Law 104-20 on 1995-07-28.

title: New law: Emergency Supplemental Appropriations for Additional Disaster Assistance, for Anti-terrorism Initiatives, for Assistance in the Recovery from the Tragedy that Occurred at Oklahoma City, and Rescissions Act, 1995 (Public Law 104-19)
summary: H.R. 1944 of the 104th Congress became Public Law 104-19 on 1995-07-27.
